The low but nonzero score reflects that in everyday reasoning people often slide from "necessary basis" to "generator," but strictly speaking this is a fallacy.

In this universe, specific brain activity patterns still correlate tightly with specific experiences (P1), and damage to particular brain regions disrupts or eliminates corresponding experiences (P2) by breaking the receiver.
